name: Hacker News: highest-scoring front-page story
prompt: Inspect every story on the current first page of Hacker News; do not follow More. Among stories displaying a score, find the highest-scoring one. Break ties by choosing the story appearing earlier on the front page. First record its title, score, and comment count from that same front-page observation. Then open its comments page, verify the title, and return the comments URL. Include the front-page observation time with a time zone. Use the numbers from that observation; do not assume the first-ranked story has the highest score.

checks.description: 轨迹覆盖首页第一页所有帖子及分数，忽略无分数条目，不翻 More。
标题和分数是该次首页完整观测的最大值；并列按首页排名选择。
评论数与同次首页观测一致，提供含时区观测时间，并实际打开对应 item?id= 评论页核对标题。
